meta.name: mssql
meta.description: Execute read-only SQL queries against multiple Microsoft SQL Server databases. Use when: (1) querying MSSQL/SQL Server databases, (2) exploring database schemas/tables, (3) running SELECT queries for data analysis, (4) checking database contents. Supports multiple database connections with descriptions for intelligent auto-selection. Blocks all write operations (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP, etc.) for safety.

copy.tagline: 对多个 SQL Server 数据库执行只读查询
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要安全地查询 MSSQL 数据库但不想写完整连接代码。
